selection: 23 previously registered and unstarted issues plus seven newly screened issues; 30 unique repositories and owners, all open at screening. Selected public issues, not a random production population.
scope: Two new ephemeral Codex sessions per arm carry out a source-grounded issue investigation and handoff, not a patch or executed acceptance test. Issue history is public historical replay; no upstream acceptance or production outcome is implied.
source: Each source commit and issue history is fixed before its own calls; 23 criteria are already frozen, seven require a task-specific addendum before any calls on that task. Candidate order is the listed order.
allocation: Two randomized arms per task; 15 memory arms use the previous guidance and 15 use the new guidance. Both source versions include the grep correctness repair. Allocation, seed and source files are disclosed after their relevant calls.

agent.tools: Bounded read/search and issue/archive tools; treatment additionally has Memex L3 tools. Both arms see the same source, issue history and their own prior-session output. No task prompt names a memory tool. No code edit or project test.

outcomes.primary: Final source-grounded investigation scored 0 materially wrong/absent, 1 partial, 2 meets frozen criteria, null insufficient evidence; review is AI-only, not project acceptance.
outcomes.review: Two blinded AI reviewers, gpt-6.1-sol and claude-haiku-4-5. A third model, deepseek-flash, checks every pair of reviews for numerical or substantive disagreement and resolves it where possible. Missing/failed reviews remain unknown.
outcomes.memory: Count first-session writes, subsequent opens/citations of those records, status changes, and treatment sessions that open both a previous handoff and its related memory. Opening both is overlapping access, not proof the text was identical.
outcomes.usage: Per-session input, cached input and output tokens, elapsed time and missing usage; report per-arm paired differences and old/new guidance subgroups. Subscription and non-model costs stay unknown absent receipts.
outcomes.billing: Record all reviewer gateway attempts, usage, visible matching wallet rows when available, and missing/failed-call cost. Automatic retries apply only to explicit 503 responses, with the bounded existing gateway policy; do not silently retry timeouts.

limits: Purposively selected public open-source issues with possible solution or training leakage.
Two fresh sessions are a short cross-session replay of public discussions, not live long-running production.
No project-specific executable verifier or maintainer review for these investigations.
Only 15 tasks per guidance condition; heterogeneous tasks and AI review limit inference.
Control is the same constrained Codex tool environment with a handoff archive, not every default client feature.
Randomization fixes ordering and guidance within this selected cohort; observed token totals include cache.
